realizes.rationale: Curator verifies this build and launch intake before using any writer.

The canonical operations/curation.md carries the applicable own-file first-read/task_doc-only write and report/scratch instructions for its role/operation; it is the source the public generator ships.
Independent fact-check is required; findings repaired with full-operation rerun.
A report naming an authorized next step needs no new Manager go and continues through the whole handover while retaining repairs, escalation and genuine stops.
Faulty input is corrected through the same writer; covered correct-write refusal triggers the named recovery detail and validator/gate findings remain repairs.

The inline selected-serving-build/clean-main producer clause remains in curation; installation, guard disabling and substituted producers remain excluded, subject only to the separately scoped correct-write recovery.
The Manager-directed authority paragraph retains the no-code/no-gate/no-lifecycle boundary while qualifying task-document edits only by the scoped recovery route.
The curation operation repeats the same recovery for the Curator of this operation, so a composed capsule cannot lose it.
Ordinary Curator start follows code PASS, while an approved prerequisite memory-sync reconciliation has its explicitly named early-start exception.
Step8 names bounded encountered-memory repairs, requires each repair be reported, forbids broad sweeps and reruns complete checks/fact-check before handover.
A next-authorized-step report needs no new Manager go; continue through the whole handover.
The curation handoff says terminal/finalizer evidence proves turn end only; it preserves direct independent memory review and excludes tool-generated acceptance claims.
Directs code concerns to both seats and keeps code repair and gate ownership external.
The partial/refused report-state boundary remains truthful, and scoped correct-write recovery does not waive validator or gate findings.
This curation-operation handoff retains the turn-end-only boundary and direct Reviewer delivery; it is not a separate Curator certification.
Curator intake preserves launch task-document and reader arguments.
Allows only native memory content repair and preserves transaction-state and staging restrictions.
Owns direct producer intake and memory delivery to Reviewer without routing its result through Manager.

Canonical operations/curation.md carries task-bound own-file first reads, exact reader scope, selected memory root and the inline serving-build producer boundary; its generated package copy ships those source instructions.
After bounded repairs, complete checks and independent fact-check remain before handover. Independent fact-check is required; findings repaired with full-operation rerun.
Curation verifies launching-build identity and supplied context before its public writer.
The Curator must personally verify each card sentence against code; a memory line is not proof.

1.note: MEMORY review stays separately sealed/counted and never opens or resets CODE review. Beyond the settings limit the architect or developer authorizes the pass and Manager records it. Curator owns corrected input/body/coherence work; transaction steps and external effects stay with their owners. The installed-build quality/coherence outcome and direct Reviewer handover remain separate from independent acceptance.

10.note: Current curation keeps Manager transaction ownership separate, requires full intake/repair MQC and the independent fact-check, and records MEMORY review separately. The normal workflow continues through bounded repair and handover without a fresh Manager go, subject to the role’s genuine stops and own-repair escalation. Canonical task edits use the primary tool and scoped correct-write recovery; none of this grants Git, closeout or acceptance authority.

14.note: Current curation continues from a report to the next authorized step without a new Manager go. It verifies card sentences against source, repairs wrong or missing memory encountered along its way beyond quality-check findings, names each repair and makes no broad sweep. Code changes, requirement decisions and another leaf’s work return to their owner. A correction qualifies every affected false body claim; full checks and the independent fact-check run before handover.
